verdicts_or_reports.expected: A whitespace-only name should be treated like an empty name: the Create button should stay disabled and no deck should be created (name should be trimmed before validation).
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Typing only spaces (" ") enables the Create button, and pressing it creates a bogus subdeck shown as "blank" ("Spanish::blank").
steps: On the deck list, long-press the deck Spanish
Leave the Name field empty and note Create is disabled
Type a single space (or several spaces)
Observe the Create button becomes enabled
Tap Create and observe a new subdeck row appears under Spanish named "blank" (deck title Spanish::blank)

verdicts_or_reports.element: Type note-model spinner on Add note screen
verdicts_or_reports.expected: After switching the note model in the Add note picker, the choice should be stored immediately, so the next time Add note is opened it should still show the newly chosen model (e.g. Cloze).
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Switching the Type picker to Cloze (or Basic (and reversed card)) and leaving the Add note screen is not persisted: reopening Add note shows "Basic" again, so the switch was never stored to the collection.

Tap the Type: spinner and select Cloze (the screen shows Type: Cloze and Cards: Cloze)
Leave the Add note screen with the back button
Open Add note again (Card browser toolbar Add)
Observe the Type spinner is back to Basic instead of the Cloze model just chosen

verdicts_or_reports.element: Statistics deck title vs Today statistics
verdicts_or_reports.expected: After choosing the deck French in the statistics deck picker and selecting the "deck" mode, the screen should show French statistics (French has no reviews today, so Today should say no cards studied, Card Counts total should be 3).
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The title bar shows "French" and the deck mode is selected, but the statistics shown are for the Spanish deck: "Studied 7 cards in 46.16 seconds today (6.59s/card)" and Card Counts total 4 (French has 3 cards and none studied today).
steps: Open Card browser for Spanish and open Statistics from the drawer (title Spanish, deck mode, search deck:current)
Tap the collection radio button (search clears, whole-collection stats shown)
Tap the deck name in the title bar and choose French from the deck picker
Observe title becomes French, search becomes deck:"French", but the collection radio is still selected
Tap the deck radio button (search becomes deck:current)
Observe the page now displays Spanish statistics (Studied 7 cards today, Card Counts total 4) while the title still says French
